meta.title: Industries · Clafina
meta.description: How Clafina runs a day in your trade: shops, restaurants, hotels, gyms, schools, clinics, builders, farms, makers and more, told in your own words.

hero.title: Your trade, in your words.
hero.lede: Every business keeps the same books, stock and customers. What changes is the day. Pick your trade and follow a day at a business like yours, from opening to close.

groups.title: Built in
groups.body: Shops and makers use the core of Clafina as it is. Nothing to switch on.

groups.title: Food, stays and bookings
groups.body: Tables, rooms, tickets and hired items, and the busy days they bring.

groups.title: Members, classes and learning
groups.body: People who come back: members, class regulars, learners and clients.

groups.title: Property, projects and jobs
groups.body: Work that runs over weeks: leases, building contracts and jobs out in the field.

groups.title: Goods on the move, and things that grow
groups.body: Routes and vans, fields and flocks, and products built to a customer's choice.

groups.title: Giving
groups.body: Donors, gifts, pledges, campaigns, grants and numbered tax receipts.

cta.title: Don't see your trade?
cta.body: Every business starts with the same core: books, stock, sales, people and an online shop. Start free and switch on the packs that fit.
